name: circuits
description: The server side of pgxsinkit's read path: the Circuits engine, which keeps shapes in sync from Postgres logical replication, and the durable-streams log server that stores and serves them.

scripts.build: bun run engine:build && bun run durable-streams:build
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.lint: oxlint -c .oxlintrc.jsonc . && bash scripts/with-toolchain.sh cargo clippy -p durable-streams --profile release-durable-streams --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: bun run engine:test && bun run test:durable-streams && bun run test:unit:ts
scripts.test:durable-streams:conformance: bun run durable-streams:build --profile release-durable-streams && bun run --cwd apps/durable-streams test:conformance
scripts.test:integration: bun run test:integration:harness && bun run test:durable-streams:conformance
scripts.validate: bun run format && bun run check
scripts.validate:full: bun run validate && bun run test:integration
